detail.longDescription: A Trump-Amodei dinner would be read in Washington and in the sector as a signal that Anthropic is seeking to repair ties with the administration after a year of legal and regulatory friction. The relationship has direct commercial stakes for the company given its ongoing dispute over Pentagon access, and any thaw could bear on how the administration approaches federal AI procurement more broadly. The timing, days before a wider meeting between Trump, House Speaker Mike Johnson and other AI executives, also puts Anthropic in the room as Congress weighs how far to go on AI guardrails, a live question for the sector's regulatory outlook.
